chunks.arabic_text: رِجَالُ الْكَشِّيِّ: حَمْدَوَيْه، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنِ ابْنِ مِسْكَانَ، عَنْ عِيسَى شَلْقَانَ قَالَ

translations.en: Rijal al-Kashshi: Hamduwayh, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Ibn Muskan, from Isa Shalqan who said:

chunks.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامِ وَهُوَ يَوْمَئِذٍ غُلَامٌ قَبْلَ أَوَانِ بُلُوغِهِ: جَعَلْتُ فَدَاكَ مَا هَذَا الَّذِي يُسْمَعُ مِنْ أَبِيهِ أَنَّهُ أَمَرَنَا بِوِلَايَةِ أَبِي الْخَطَّابِ ثُمَّ أَمَرَنَا بِالْبَرَاءَةِ مِنْهُ؟

translations.en: I said to Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) when he was still a boy before he reached puberty: May I be made your ransom, what is this we hear from your father, that he ordered us to associate with Abi al-Khattab then he ordered us to disassociate from him?

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ: فَقَالَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ مِنْ تِلْقَاءِ نَفْسِهِ: إِنَّ اللَّهَ خَلَقَ الْأَنْبِيَاءَ عَلَى النُّبُوَّةِ فَلَا يَكُونُونَ إِلَّا أَنْبِيَاءَ وَخَلَقَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَى الْإِيمَانِ فَلَا يَكُونُونَ إِلَّا مُؤْمِنِينَ وَاسْتَوْدَعَ قَوْمًا إِيمَانًا فَإِنْ شَاءَ أَتَمَّهُ لَهُمْ وَإِنْ شَاءَ سَلَبَهُمْ إِيَّاهُ، وَإِنَّ أَبَا الْخَطَّابِ كَانَ مِمَّنْ أَعَارَهُ اللَّهُ الْإِيمَانَ فَلَمَّا كَذَبَ عَلَى أَبِيهِ سَلَبَهُ اللَّهُ الْإِيمَانَ

translations.en: He said: So Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) said of his own volition: Allah created the prophets on prophethood, so they do not become except prophets. He created the believers on belief, so they do not become except believers. But he deposited belief in a group, so if He wishes He completes it for them, and if He wishes He takes it away from them. Abi al-Khattab was one of those whose faith was loaned out to him by Allah, so when he lied about my father – Allah took away that faith from him.

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ: فَعَرَضْتُ هَذَا الْكَلَامَ عَلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ قَالَ: قَالَ: لَوْ سَأَلْتَنَا عَنْ ذَلِكَ مَا كَانَ لِيَكُونَ عِنْدَنَا غَيْرُ مَا قَالَ

translations.en: He [Isa] said: I repeated these words to Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him) so he said: If you had asked us about that [the same question] we would not have anything different to say to you.

en.summary: This narration, transmitted via Al-Kashi’s chain, highlights the theological principle of 'I'arat al-Iman' (loaned faith), where Imam al-Kadhim clarifies that while prophethood is an innate, immutable status, faith can be temporarily granted and subsequently revoked based on divine will and specific actions like lying. This explanation resolves the apparent contradiction in the commands regarding Abi al-Khattab by distinguishing between his inherent status and the conditional nature of the faith he possessed, a view later corroborated by Imam al-Sadiq. It underscores the Shia scholarly understanding of divine discretion in maintaining or withdrawing spiritual states from individuals within the community.
en.seo_question: Why did the Imams first order association with Abi al-Khattab and then order disassociation from him?

key_terms.أَبُو الْخَطَّابِ: Abi al-Khattab, a contemporary figure whose faith was considered loaned and later revoked
